verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same broken structure. The CTA comes first on the left, ahead of the brand and headline. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline instead of above it. The flavour pills are in reverse order. The subcopy is squeezed into a cramped two-line block beside the pills. The legal text floats to the right at about the same weight as the subcopy, leaving a large dead gap in the middle. B is slightly worse: its CTA is jammed against the left canvas edge, and the decorative circle is pushed to the far right, so the left half reads as cramped. A keeps a margin and keeps the circles behind the button.
